entries.failure_mode: Sampling boundary contamination: TM strips include uvea/ciliary body/limbal components, anatomical adjacency determines composition.
entries.observable_signature: Iris sphincter/ciliary muscle signatures appearing in TM samples = normal sampling contamination.
entries.mitigation: Citations of TM composition must include sampling protocol description (blunt strip / with or without SC / presence of iridocorneal angle); judge 'iris sphincter/ciliary muscle signatures in TM samples' as normal contamination, not doublets.

entries.failure_mode: Nuclear suspension platforms lose TM cytoplasmic transcripts (contractile apparatus/ECM-related genes); in-library anchor establishes the 100%-nucleus caliber only.
entries.observable_signature: In-library scRNA comparison anchors are mostly cultured systems — culture state confounds the platform axis, so signature differences cannot be attributed to the nucleus/cell platform alone; cytoplasmic-signature under-read in nucleus data is disclosed with the confound.
entries.mitigation: Forbid bare nucleus-suspension readings for TM contractile/ECM claims, flag intronic risk; cross-platform comparisons (snRNA vs cultured scRNA) listed separately, never averaged — in-library scRNA comparison anchors are mostly cultured systems, culture state confounds the platform axis, signature differences cannot be attributed to the platform alone.
